notes: Exalted: The Abyssals supplied and intake in progress. 265 rows reviewed and inventoried under docs/references/exalted1e/abyssal/inventory/: the character-creation overview, the universal Anima Effect, all five Castes, the Abyssal Curse, the Virtues of Death, the full Resonance mechanic (gain/loss/manipulation), the-title, Useful Crafts, the Cult exclusion sidebar, the six new deathknight-only Backgrounds, the altered Backgrounds, all 228 Chapter Five Charm rows covering every Ability line for all five Castes (Dusk, Midnight, Daybreak, Day, Moonshadow), and the start of Chapter Six's necromancy system (framework overview plus all 9 Shadowlands Circle spells). Nothing promoted to a production catalog yet. Chapter Six's Labyrinth and Void Circle necromancy spells, the Craft (Necrosurgery/etc.) rules, and Abyssal-specific Merits/Flaws (not yet located) are not yet inventoried; a handful of Chapter Five rows need a dedicated tree-topology disambiguation pass, two rows (soaring-raptor-prana, striking-snake-grab) need a follow-up close read, and one row (corpus-rending-blow) is an explicit unresolved placeholder for a missing Charm write-up (see source-manifest.json rulesNotes) before promotion. Locked pending the remaining inventory, schema/rules/creator/editor implementation, and passing tests across all five planned families.
